Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Ledger rows for posted Nivelacije in the period. Sibling of TK__GetZaduzenje / TK__GetRazduzenje — same {status, rows, errors} contract, same row shape.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text:
Expects JSON: { "companyID": <text>, "datumOd": <date>, "datumDo": <date> } Returns JSON: { "status": "success|fail", "rows": [], "errors": [] }
ONE DOCUMENT, EITHER COLUMN. A nivelacija raises or lowers the retail value of goods already charged into the book, so it is neither purely a zaduzenje nor purely a razduzenje — the sign of UkupnoRazlika decides which column it lands in. That is why it is its own worker rather than a branch inside TK__GetZaduzenje.
GROSS, NEVER NET. The ledger is kept at maloprodajna vrijednost, so the figure is UkupnoRazlika — the VAT-inclusive difference. UkupnoRazlikaRUC is the net movement and belongs on the printed nivelacija form, never here. The two differ on every document and are never derived from each other.
ZERO-EFFECT DOCUMENTS EMIT NOTHING. A hold-the-price nivelacija (NacinIzmjene "ZadrziMPC") moves no retail value at all: it reclassifies VAT out of the margin and leaves maloprodajna vrijednost untouched. N-001-26 is exactly that — 67 lines, UkupnoRazlika 0,00. Emitting a 0,00 / 0,00 row for it would renumber every subsequent RedniBroj in an already-filed period while changing no saldo, which is a worse outcome than the row's absence. The document still exists, is numbered, and is filed on its own; it simply has nothing to say to the trgovacka knjiga.
SORT ORDER 2 — after kalkulacije (1), before sales (3). Goods must be charged into the book before they can be repriced, and repriced before the day's takings discharge them.
SQL rather than a find: there is no layout on the Nivelacija table, and this needs none.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Validation mirrors the sibling workers exactly, so a caller gets the same failure shape whichever leg rejects. ──

Value.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( $errors ; "[+]" ; "datumOd ne može biti veći od datumDo" ; JSONString )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Dates go in as ? parameters carrying native FM date values. A quoted date STRING in FM SQL compares lexicographically and gives wrong answers without ever erroring. Tab and carriage return as separators are safe here because every selected column is a key, a document number, a date or a number — none can contain either character. ──

Value.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( $errors ; "[+]" ; "SQL greška pri čitanju nivelacija" ; JSONString )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── A zero-effect document is skipped here rather than in the WHERE clause. FileMaker SQL predicates on absent or zero values have a habit of failing open into silent row loss, and a filter that quietly dropped a real nivelacija would be far worse than one extra iteration. ──
